roles_en: Minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_en: Arsham Khondkarian was a member of parliament and a minister in the ARF government of the Republic of Armenia, born and educated in Armenia. In exile he lived in France. Late in life he visited Soviet Armenia with a tourist group - the first former Dashnak minister to do so - and joked with a young reporter that he had come 'to overthrow the Bolshevik order'. He died soon after his return, in late 1965.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death in late 1965 (Haratch editorial of 4 Dec 1965); exact date not given.
